checks.note: Quickstart confirms API key sent as Bearer token, created in Studio. No OAuth for API. Device-code login is for local MCP only (page doesn't call it OAuth).
Pricing page: Standard plan labeled Free with one-time $150 usage, then standard rates. No gating stated; eligibility FAQ and key-role limits not visible, so unverified.
Docs home lists /parse, /extract, /split, /classify, /edit. REST inferred from the cURL example; breadth 'moderate' is a judgment.
Hosted server at mcp.reducto.ai/mcp with bearer key, local uvx package, 9 tools, documented on vendor docs. The page doesn't say 'official', but it is vendor-hosted on Reducto's domain and docs.

Self-serve key, documented REST API and vendor MCP. Caveats: free credit is one-time $150, and key-creation permissions and base URL are unconfirmed. Verdict is better as ready_with_caveats than ready.

corrected.one_liner: Reducto is an API and visual Studio platform that parses, extracts structured data from, splits, classifies and edits PDFs and other documents for AI pipelines.
corrected.auth_notes: API key created in Studio (studio.reducto.ai/api-keys) and sent as 'Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY'. No OAuth flow for third-party apps documented. The local MCP server also supports a browser login (--login) that saves a key locally.
corrected.access_notes: Pricing page: Standard plan is labeled Free with a one-time $150 in free usage, then standard pay-as-you-go rates. Sign up via Studio and create a key. The pricing FAQ on key access and credit eligibility is not visible. Key-creation role limits are unverified. Standard rate limits: 500 concurrent pages (r-1), 50 (r-1 mini, table partly garbled).
corrected.blocker: Free credit is one-time ($150). Base URL only seen in a cURL example (platform.reducto.ai). Key-creation permissions and credit eligibility unverified. Hosted MCP cannot read local file paths.

evidence.auth: https://docs.reducto.ai/quickstart — Authorization: Bearer $REDUCTO_API_KEY; key created in Studio API Keys
evidence.access: https://reducto.ai/pricing — Standard plan free to start with $150 in free usage; Parse/Extract/Edit/Split included
